text: Our city's new policing strategy is a tremendous success. Since we implemented it six months ago, car thefts have dropped by 22%. The numbers speak for themselves. Critics who oppose this approach are ignoring the hard data that proves it works. This is exactly the kind of result-driven leadership our community needs.
